node.title: Re: Creating data delimited by ASCII code 1 using perl
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Any suggestion how to create a file where the values are separated by ASCII code 1 (binary1)

In Perl, that can be represented in a double-quoted string as "\x01" or "\001" ([id://11101667|among others]). As for the rest of your question, please see [id://174051].
